reviews.shade: BRINGGREEN Tea Tree Cica Pore Clay Pack Strong 100g
reviews.text:
I got a sample of this in Seoul and loved it, so now I’ve finally bought the full size. This mask is very good for the summer if you have oily/combination skin. Draws out the impurities and balances out the skin.
I love it. Keep it in the fridge for added freshness :)
reviews.zh: 喺首爾攞到 sample 試完覺得好正，所以終於買咗正裝。夏天如果係油性肌或者混合性肌，呢個 mask 好啱用。抽走污垢同平衡肌膚。我好鍾意。擺入雪櫃再用更加 fresh :)

reviews.shade: BRINGGREEN Tea Tree Cica Pore Clay Pack Strong 100g
reviews.text: It does everything it says it does! It works perfectly. My only concern is the chunks it has, which are a bit rough to clean because they stick to the skin while cleansing. Other than that, my skin feels calm thanks to the cooling sensation it gives, very clean and smooth with fewer visible pores afterward.
reviews.zh: 佢做到所有聲稱嘅嘢！效果完美。我唯一擔心係入面嘅粒粒，比較難清潔，因為清潔嗰陣會黐住皮膚。除此之外，佢帶嚟嘅涼感令皮膚感到舒緩，用完之後皮膚好乾淨同滑，毛孔都冇咁明顯。

reviews.shade: BRINGGREEN Tea Tree Cica Pore Clay Pack Strong 100g
reviews.text: My fav clay pack. I will use once a week for a good clean. Can feel the pores are very clean after used and face feel not so dry too. I will stock up if got more promotion.
reviews.zh: 我最鍾意嘅泥 mask。一個星期用一次做深層清潔。用完之後 feel 到毛孔好乾淨，塊面又唔會太乾。如果再有多啲 promotion 我會入多啲貨。

reviews.shade: BRINGGREEN Tea Tree Cica Pore Clay Pack Strong 100g
reviews.text: Genius, what a lifesaver for dry skin on the winter when the hormonal acne creeps in. My skin is looking even after just one use too. Perfect addition to my squid game routine.
reviews.zh: 天才之作，冬天荷爾蒙瘡冒起嘅時候，對乾性肌嚟講真係救星。用完一次皮膚已經望落均勻咗。完美加入我嘅 squid game 護膚程序。

reviews.shade: BRINGGREEN Tea Tree Cica Pore Clay Pack Strong 100g
reviews.text: it feels like the one from body shop and dont think it really do much
reviews.zh: 用落似 body shop 嗰個，覺得佢冇咩特別效果。

reviews.shade: BRINGGREEN Tea Tree Cica Pore Clay Pack Strong 100g
reviews.text:
It has a fresh, herbal scent and a beautiful green color with real leaf particles.
Feels super refreshing on the skin, and you can actually feel it working — my pores looked much cleaner after just one use.
Definitely satisfied!
reviews.zh: 有清新嘅草本香同靚綠色，入面有真嘅葉碎。搽上皮膚超 refreshing，感覺到佢真係有用——用完一次毛孔已經睇落乾淨好多。非常滿意！

reviews.shade: BRINGGREEN Tea Tree Cica Pore Clay Pack Strong 100g
reviews.text: The mask itself is nice, it leaves a nice feeling once you washed off. The only negative for my personal preference is the tea leaves, it’s chunky and those chunks of leaves dirties the sink. I would have preferred the leaves getting grind down finer.
reviews.zh: 面膜本身唔錯，洗走之後皮膚感覺幾舒服。唯一一個我個人覺得唔好嘅位就係啲茶葉——葉太大塊，洗嘅時候啲碎葉會整污糟個洗手盆。如果可以磨得再幼細啲就好喇。

reviews.shade: BRINGGREEN Tea Tree Cica Pore Clay Pack Strong 100g
reviews.text: The texture of the clay itself is nice and i like the smell of tea tree so you can’t go wring with this. My only concern is the grains. They are a bit big so I’m not sure if they will break apart in the drain or clog it. I recommend wiping it off with a damp towel before washing the rest of the clay off over the sink!
reviews.zh: 泥本身嘅質地唔錯，我又鍾意茶樹味，所以基本上冇得輸。我唯一擔心嘅係啲粒子，粒子偏大，唔知沖水嗰陣會唔會散開定係塞住個去水管。建議用濕毛巾先抹走，再開水沖走其餘嘅泥！

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
